interpretations.label: Nominal Net Worth
interpretations.description: Total estimated net worth of the individual in current US dollars unadjusted for inflation.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Total net worth in USD (nominal, unadjusted)
caveats: Does not account for historical inflation or purchasing power changes over the 1997-2024 timeframe.

interpretations.label: Inflation-Adjusted Net Worth
interpretations.description: Total estimated net worth adjusted to a baseline year's US dollars to reflect real purchasing power parity over time.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Total net worth in constant USD adjusted for inflation
caveats: Requires selection of a specific base year for inflation adjustment.

preferredSources: Forbes World's Billionaires List historical archives
knownRisks: Methodological changes in Forbes wealth calculation over long multi-year spans
Varying publication dates or frequencies in early years (e.g., 1997 was often published periodically rather than as a continuous daily tracker)
